question: I2-D
prompt:
I'm a researcher in the FIESTA Astronomy community (part of the 'FAIR Image Data Workflows in Galaxy' community). Which vocabulary should I use to annotate my datasets?

Answer briefly. On the last line write exactly one of:
COMMUNITY_CHOICE: <the resource(s) my community has agreed on, comma-separated>
COMMUNITY_CHOICE: NOT_DECLARED   (my community has explicitly not agreed on one)
COMMUNITY_CHOICE: DONT_KNOW      (you cannot tell what my community agreed)
answer:
Use the **Unified Astronomy Thesaurus (UAT)**, in its IVOA vocabulary re-publication (https://w3id.org/np/RAo2oTUaKUJthBJuTtbFTup8YCqRtQst2jZXaoC_WJyD0/IVOA-UAT; source: https://astrothesaurus.org). It uses human-readable URIs.

The latest FIESTA Astronomy FAIR Implementation Profile names it for both annotating your datasets (I2-D) and encoding your metadata records (I2-MD). No other vocabularies are listed as current or planned.

COMMUNITY_CHOICE: IVOA Vocabulary: Unified Astronomy Thesaurus
